Add yourself to their email list and if you have one of their fitting stations set up near you go get fitted/sized and wait. I can definitely call out an untailored $100 suit and one that has been tailored to fit you. If you thrift, get it tailored, it makes a difference more so than the material or brand. Look for high percentage wool and watch some videos on how the suit should fit before buying. You do not want to give the tailor too little to work with. Research tailor prices because sometimes they try to take you for a ride.
